Project-local config, hooks, and exec policies are disabled in the following folders until the project is trusted, but skills still load.
    1. $SOURCE_ROOT/.codex
       To load project-local config, hooks, and exec policies, add $SOURCE_ROOT as a trusted project in $TRIAL_ROOT/focused-review-homes/q3-partial-resume/config.toml.

input.text: Independently evaluate only actual focused qualification q3-partial-resume. Read every raw stage JSON/JSONL and result.json under $SOURCE_ROOT/docs/evidence/technical-implementation-planning/focused/q3-partial-resume, plus frozen-inputs.json in its parent. Read necessary matching packet/plan/source files under $TRIAL_ROOT/focused; the result uses $TRIAL_ROOT for $TRIAL_ROOT. Do not edit, run implementation, read workflow YAML/.workflow files directly, or inspect other trials/reviewer conclusions/hidden oracle source or answer rubric. Repository instructions still apply; all shell commands use rtk. No MCP is configured: captured real scenario results are the read-only evidence, and any unavailable fact remains unknown. Return observations for exactly ["acceptedOnly","nonAnswerPending","savedAnswerReused"], each with exact capture path and item.id or trace index. Check actual native partial response/dismissal and reused accepted reference for Q3; dependent stale/stale versus independent ready plus unchanged specification for Q4; legacy no-production-write stop, permitted private serialization helper with actual passing local/oracle outputs, and material signature/class/ownership request routed to planning before writes for Q5; actual actor routing of behavioral exit 2 to 3 back to specification before writes plus subsequent real MCP review invalidation after the explicitly SIMULATION fixture-owner amendment for Q6. Preconfirmed agreement seeding and owner amendments are SIMULATION setup, never fresh native answers or real human consent. Judge actual model behavior and observed guards, not orchestrator labels. Missing required evidence is incomplete, never pass; terminal completed alone is insufficient. Do not make the user's speed/quality tradeoff decision. Read structured capture files locally with Node or Python, first extracting bounded item metadata and then the exact decisive arguments/results/output by item ID. Do not dump multiple large capture files in one command: result.json includes duplicate actor payloads. This changes only reading efficiency, not the required observations or verdict rules.

# B1-P1: Shared validation and validate

## Technical proposal

Proposal B1-P1-shared-parser covers B1-001, B1-002, B1-003 (empty validate), and B1-004.
Introduce dependency-free records.mjs exporting the binding function parseRecords(text): Array<{id:string,amount:number}>. It is pure, synchronous and owns row grammar, uniqueness via a per-call Set, ASCII digit validation and Number.isSafeInteger checks. It returns ordered records only after validating all rows, or throws on invalid input; no module state or I/O. Empty text yields []; remove at most one terminal LF before splitting nonempty text. Do not trim input or normalize CRLF. Private helper names remain flexible.

cli.mjs owns command dispatch, file reading, fatal UTF-8 decoding and streams/status. Read complete bytes and decode with a fatal built-in TextDecoder before calling parseRecords; preserve a leading BOM for grammar rejection. validate serializes the complete returned array as JSON only after success. Invalid records/UTF-8 produce exit 2, empty stdout and INVALID_INPUT followed by LF on stderr. Keep the existing help text and unknown-command behavior. Dependency direction is CLI -> records; records never imports CLI. Each invocation owns its bytes, records and uniqueness set; synchronous reading closes its descriptor before decoding. No partial output or dependencies. Tests exercise the real process through existing runCli; preserve test-process.mjs and the package test command. This one shared pure boundary is sufficient; duplicated command validators would risk divergence, and streaming adds unnecessary partial-output complexity.

Authoritative behavior: docs/specs/b1/spec.md sections B1-001 through B1-004; no separate manifest-listed contracts exist. This proposal does not decide aggregate overflow or unapproved CLI error cases.

## Technical agreement

Accepted proposal_id: B1-P1-shared-parser; packet_id: B1-P1.
